    AI Overview
    Harry Diamond is Rory McIlroy’s caddie and a close childhood friend from Northern Ireland, having been on his bag since 2017. A former accomplished amateur golfer, Diamond replaced J.P. Fitzgerald to provide a calm, loyal presence. The pair have shared numerous successes, including major wins and the 2025 Masters. 
    Key Facts About Harry Diamond: 
    • Relationship: They met at Holywood Golf Club as children and are best friends; Diamond was the best man at McIlroy's wedding.
    • Background: A talented player, Diamond won the 2012 West of Ireland Championship.
    • Career as Caddie: He began working with McIlroy in 2017 after a temporary stint, becoming permanent shortly after.
    • Successes: Supported McIlroy during multiple wins, including the 2025 Masters.
    • Style: Known for being a calming influence and rarely engaging with media, as shown in the Golf Monthly profile. 
    While often facing criticism from media pundits, McIlroy has strongly defended Diamond, emphasizing his confidence in their partnership.
